raw_posts.name: Zoom Slides
raw_posts.tagline: Turn your Zoom meetings into ready-to-present slides
raw_posts.description: Zoom Slides is an AI-powered presentation maker that turns your meetings, documents, and ideas into polished, editable decks. Instead of starting from a blank slide, let Zoom AI turn meeting transcripts and summaries into structured presentations with professional layouts, visuals, and speaker notes. Refine content with AI, collaborate with teammates, and export to PowerPoint. Your meeting ends, and your presentation is already taking shape.

raw_posts.name: Boost.space AgentOS
raw_posts.tagline: One operating system for all your AI agents
raw_posts.description: Build your agent-driven company with specialized agents that share context, skills, and tools. Deploy, control, manage and chat or talk to your agents with access to more than 1,400 AI models and access to more than 1,500 tools you already use.

raw_posts.name: readywhen
raw_posts.tagline: Your personal assistant that lives in email around the clock
raw_posts.description: readywhen is the personal assistant on email. Email it a job, the same way you'd email a good assistant. It writes the follow-up, sends it from your email when you reply "send", then watches for the answer. Ask what you're waiting on. Nothing goes out without your OK. Just email assistant@readywhen.ai to get started. No account setup needed.

raw_posts.name: OpenBot
raw_posts.tagline: Grok Bot alternative: self-host, fully customize, any stack
raw_posts.description: Build your own enterprise-ready agent workspace that's modular and self-hostable. Designed with a clean architecture and built-in governance. Bring any agent- then choose the models, tools, and infra they run on. Use as-is, white-label it, or deeply customize it.

raw_posts.name: OpenFrame
raw_posts.tagline: AI agents that run your IT. You approve every fix.
raw_posts.description: OpenFrame gives small IT teams two AI agents to handle the work that never ends. Mingo patches devices, fixes issues, and handles routine technical tasks, with every change approved by your admin. Fae answers employee IT requests so your team can focus without constant interruptions. A weekly report shows leadership what got done. Endpoint management, AI agents, and IT support in one platform for $1 per device.

raw_posts.name: Cal.com v7
raw_posts.tagline: Cal.com now has events, discover, an assistant + more
raw_posts.description: Officially launching Cal.com Events, Cal.com Discover, Cal.ai Assistant, a new brand and more!

raw_posts.name: ChatGPT Wallet
raw_posts.tagline: Let ChatGPT agents buy things without seeing your card
raw_posts.description: ChatGPT Wallet lets OpenAI's "dots" agents finish purchases for you. The card network gives the agent a payment token, so neither the agent nor the merchant ever sees your card number. You review the items, the total and the card before each purchase, then approve with Face ID or a fingerprint. Built with American Express, Mastercard and Visa.

raw_posts.name: Cookie Away
raw_posts.tagline: Rejects cookie banners for you, even the sneaky ones
raw_posts.description: Cookie Away is a free, open-source Chrome extension that rejects cookie banners for you. No reject button? It opens the settings, switches everything off and saves. It never pays to say no, checks every click, and we published its results on 69 sites.

raw_posts.name: Pharen Hub
raw_posts.tagline: One AI workspace for your whole company
raw_posts.description: Pharen Hub brings projects, tasks, docs, mail, meetings, data and AI agents into one workspace with one shared context. Agents work with clear goals, allowed sources and human approval. Hosted in the EU or on your own servers. Fair-code, source on GitHub. Free plan to start.

raw_posts.name: Trusty CSV
raw_posts.tagline: Edit CSV files like code, not like a spreadsheet
raw_posts.description: Data prep without the project, the flow or the script. Open a CSV and work on the file itself: cluster similar values, pivot, join, filter, or just type in a cell. Every step is one Ctrl+Z, and a diff of the saved file shows only what you changed.
